# Official OKF sample bundles

The Markdown files and `acme_retail/attesters/sql_equality.py` below this
directory are copied unchanged from the `bundles/` directory of
[GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/open-knowledge-format)
at commit `ad30107c31c06aec8a7d5636e0d1058118604e6f` (OKF v0.2). The
generated `viz.html` viewers are not included.

They are licensed under the Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE.txt`. They are
used by `tests/okf_test.rs` as conformance fixtures (#858). Update them
together with `SPEC_COMMIT` in `src/okf/mod.rs`.
